newsitem.title: USA: Furniture Brands to redeem warrants.
newsitem.headline: Furniture Brands to redeem warrants.

text.p: Furniture Brands International Inc said Monday it will redeem all outstanding Series 1 warrants.
The redemption price of $0.006 per warrant will be paid for all warrants not exercised on or before August 15 and properly tendered.
Each Series 1 warrant gives the holder the right to purchase one share of Furniture Brands common stock at $7.13 a share. Furniture Brands shares closed July 3 at 19-1/8 a share.
Based on the June 30 closing price of $19.375 a share, each warrant had approximately $12.25 in value if and when exercised, Furniture Brands said.

Warrant holders have until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT August 15 to validly exercise their warrants. Holders of warrants not received on or before that date will be entitled only to the $0.006 redemption price, the company said.
A broker protection period of three business days will be provided with respect to the exercise of the warrants.

Furniture Brands, through its Broyhill Furniture Industries Inc, Lane Co Inc and Thomasville Furniture Industries Inc subsidiaries, is the largest manufacturer of residential furniture in the United States.
